:::{#exr-sum-of-elements-practice}
#### Totalling the units sold across three items

A shop sells $22$, $12$ and $11$ units of three items over two months,
stored as

$$
\vx = \sbmat{22 \\ 12 \\ 11}.
$$

Find $\sumof{\vx}$,
the [sum of the elements](#def-sum-of-elements) of $\vx$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Use @def-sum-of-elements with $p = 3$,
as in @exm-sum-of-elements.

:::

:::
